title: Compliance Memorandum: Plan Member Waivers and Sensor Refill Deliveries, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
Compliance memorandum on liability notices — Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, Larkfield Medical Supply.

Subject: what a sensor refill (A4239) delivery carries when part of it is exposed, on a tier where each refill requires the customer's own confirmation, for a refill drawing on the authorization grant resting on the newest written order of the item.

### 1. Waiver required for early blocks

Blocks of a refill that begin before the latest refill's supply ends ship only after a plan member waiver for the item, dated on or after the newest written order, stands signed on the program.

Put the other way round, with the same strength: while no plan member waiver for the item dated on or after the newest written order stands signed on the program, a block of the refill that begins before the latest refill's supply ends does not ship.

### 2. What the waiver on file lets ship

The plan member waiver on file replaces the waiting rule of the delivery, under which a delivery with exposed units waits. The exposed units are the units at risk plus the units beyond the payer authorization. Reading the latest plan member waiver signed for the item on the program — its signature date and the billing units it covers — and the order date of the newest written order of the item:

1. When a plan member waiver for the item is dated on or after the newest written order's date, the delivery ships less any exposed units beyond the waiver's units: it ships all of its units when the waiver covers every exposed unit, and otherwise ships its units less the exposed units the waiver does not cover.
2. When the latest plan member waiver is dated earlier, it covers the superseded supply, not this delivery, so the delivery ships less its exposed units, never fewer than none.
3. Otherwise, with no plan member waiver for the item on the program, the standard waiting rule applies: the delivery ships in full, all of its units, when it has no exposed units, and otherwise waits, shipping nothing.

A waiver signed on the newest written order's date itself falls under rule 1.

### 3. Illustrations (hypothetical units)

| Waiver on file | Delivery units | Exposed units | Waiver units | Units the waiver rules let ship |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| dated on or after the newest order's date | 3 | 2 | 1 | 2 — one exposed unit lies beyond the waiver |
| dated on or after the newest order's date | 3 | 2 | 2 | 3 — every exposed unit is covered |
| dated on or after the newest order's date | 3 | 2 | 5 | 3 |
| latest waiver dated before the newest order's date | 3 | 2 | any | 1 |
| latest waiver dated before the newest order's date | 3 | 4 | any | 0 |
| no plan member waiver for the item on the program | 3 | 0 | — | 3 |
| no plan member waiver for the item on the program | 3 | 2 | — | 0 |

Under rule 2 the units of the earlier waiver play no part: that waiver belongs to the supply ordered before the newest written order.
